milestones.name: Core on one server (Go; generations; Compose)

core-plan-apply.summary: M1 full CLI cycle verified on reset Ubuntu lab in 77.902 s: pinned apply/no-op/selective changes, rollback, health failure, contention, real CLI kill, GC and scoped destroy.

recipe-format.summary: Recipe schema and loader support command, writable, build, MCP style, skills mode and channel env maps.

first-recipes.summary: Hermes, Codex and OpenCode recipes build offline with shared MCP, skills and Telegram; server deploy pending.

shared-mcps-skills.summary: One MCP and skill definition renders into YAML, TOML and JSON; skills mount or copy per recipe.

channels.summary: Hermes Telegram renders as environment variables with a required allow-list; live bot test pending.
